scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && node scripts/prune-cap-dist.mjs && cap sync
scripts.cap:copy: npm run build && node scripts/prune-cap-dist.mjs && cap copy
scripts.cap:apk: npm run build && node scripts/prune-cap-dist.mjs && cap sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
